title: Noisy odd BLR test family
statement: For a noise parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta<\tfrac12$ and a positive integer $n$, define a sign tester on $n$ coordinates by applying noise preprocessing at rate determined by $\delta$ to the odd BLR tester on $n$ coordinates.
caveat: The underlying odd BLR tester and noise-rate construction are opaque in the supplied definitions, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be stated here.
